hotspot: uvahotspot/HotSpot master, built from source on macOS
config: ambient and r_convec from the channels; sink side 0.168 m (from h = 1/(r*0.0282 m^2) in the data); spreader 1.2x chip; per-block resistivity from local_thermal_k; other parameters HotSpot defaults
verdict: HotSpot reproduces the generator's tool but not its hidden package configuration: on level4 chips it under-predicts the hotspot by ~18 K; on the level5 chips it is within 3.4 K (see backend_comparison.csv). The timeout path is covered by tests/test_external_backend.cpp.
